cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Make the Second Step First
cards.instruction: Get them to accept a small consequence that makes the larger risky action feel already underway.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Tell the committee we're considering the festival bid. Just the announcement. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Once they've reserved the date, we'll have something worth protecting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I prefer starting with the consequence that encourages us.
